verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference API provider. Its evidence shows APIs, recipes such as RAG and invoice extraction, and a console for keys and usage. These are developer building blocks for building insight features, not a built-in capability that gives users AI-generated insights or suggestions from their data inside the product. No documented in-product insights feature appears in the evidence, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
